policy: Supplemental fresh-process CLI boundary only: spawn through drained stdout or completed output file. SVG uses6 fixed inputs/5 families; Unicode terminal uses3/2. Input-file setup and independent artifact qualification occur outside each clock. Identical frozen source/label cohorts for every variant; all required cases must pass exactly once in every round. Alternate forward/reverse variant order. Shared OS/filesystem caches are not cold-disk guarantees. Node CLI and compiled Bun CLI are variants of the same catalog tool, never additional catalog nodes. No broad feature coverage is inferred. Previous published community ranks are not mutated.
resourcePolicy: Separate GNU time diagnostic after all uninstrumented latency rounds finish. Actual reviewed command/stdout qualification retained; wrapper elapsed never enters speed ranks. Fixed-cohort child peak RSS includes runtime/shared code; maximum across per-case high-water marks, not sum. User/system CPU sums across fresh per-case processes and is quantized to10ms per field. Total CPU bounds allow20ms per case in either direction (lower bounded by0); all-zero totals are censored below resolution, never free cost. These are conservative reporting-grain bounds, not statistical confidence intervals; no CPU speed ranks. Shared OS/filesystem caches; native process RSS is not PSS, a process-tree sum, incremental allocation, or leak proof. External runtime executable bytes are not npm delivery/dependency closure.
